dream: The tall rock rolled sideways, sinking deep into the wide anchor as if the base were made of water. The wide anchor tried to bite the tall rock but only made a wet squelch. The card hummed a low, steady note that felt like a breath from a mouth I could not find. The round urn tumbled over, pouring out nothing but the memory of a heavy top edge. In the end, the dark tree bent double, pressing the whole weight of the air onto the slip, until the slip finally gave way and slid away into nothing.
